The '''Royal Academy of Government''' was a [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] leadership academy that was located in the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].

==History==
This building consisted of several stories and was used to groom children to become future Mandalore government officials. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the cadets [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie]] ([[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine's]] own nephew), [[Amis/Legends|Amis]], [[Lagos/Legends|Lagos]], and [[Soniee/Legends|Soniee]] studied at the Academy, and they along with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] played a key role in exposing a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] conspiracy on Mandalore. Students at the academy were well versed in both [[Aurebesh/Legends|''Aurebesh'']] and [[Mandalorian (writing system)/Legends|''Mandalorian'']].
